rule: C0, the unmutated control, runs first and must be GREEN; each mutation must go RED with its own failure line; C10, a proper correction row, and C11, a proper row naming the addendum, must stay GREEN.

controls.expected_message: names no entry in the evidence it names
failure_lines: R1-001: n=999 names no entry in the evidence it names

controls.mutation: a row's target names the wrong locus
failure_lines: R1-001: target boonin-critique#short != evidence #60 boonin-critique#note
R1-001: verdict 'MAYBE' is not HOLDS or FAILS

controls.mutation: a FAILS row loses its stronger line
failure_lines: R1-001: FAILS without its stronger-continuation line

controls.mutation: an entry ruled twice, no supersedes
failure_lines: R1-076: #60 ruled twice without superseding R1-001

controls.mutation: the evidence file moves by one byte
failure_lines: evidence md5: file is 2567510cbca299e47e602543252473fb, header names 719b5ddb27680f32181a8a953c84b6c2
R1-001: names evidence md5 719b5ddb27680f32181a8a953c84b6c2, which is neither the evidence file (2567510cbca299e47e602543252473fb) nor the pinned addendum (ba55917f971520743773f0eb6fb518ea)
R1-001: n=60 names no entry in the evidence it names

controls.mutation: the map file moves by one byte
failure_lines: map md5: file is 55a44e3139cd38df9a05dd338424d107, header names 681827419df72a16a7c6fe70df8fe77f, evidence records 681827419df72a16a7c6fe70df8fe77f

controls.mutation: a committed row is edited in place
failure_lines: append-only: committed row R1-001 was edited or removed
R1-002: row ids must run R1-001, R1-002, ... in file order (expected R1-001)
R1-003: row ids must run R1-001, R1-002, ... in file order (expected R1-002)
R1-004: row ids must run R1-001, R1-002, ... in file order (expected R1-003)

controls.mutation: a row for n=70 names the addendum
a row for n=70 names the evidence file
